description: Say something in a room as the organization's owner: text, chat_id (the first chat when absent). Its agents may answer, and its linked channels carry it out. Ask before writing where people read. -- MakeHybrid API plan, POST /rooms/{id}/messages, group rooms.

id.description: Value for the {id} segment of /rooms/{id}/messages. Required; pass it raw (it is URL-escaped for you).

query.description: Optional query-string parameters, e.g. {"limit":"20","cursor":"..."}. Values are coerced to strings.
